subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the canonical Teams inbound attachment fix be the broader no-new-config channel repair, a narrowed config-gated group-chat repair, or a combined PR?
rationale: The issue has one proof-sufficient broad candidate and one newer config-gated partial candidate, and the choice changes operator-facing fallback behavior and config surface.

options.title: Land the broader channel repair
options.body: Use the proof-sufficient broader PR as the canonical fix because it covers all three channel root causes without adding a new config key.

options.title: Narrow the config-gated PR
options.body: Keep the new flag limited to the proven group-chat variant and leave the channel issue owned by the broader fix path.

options.title: Combine the approaches
options.body: Require one PR to include the channel URL fixes plus any explicit opt-in policy maintainers want before closing the issue.

recommendation.title: Land the broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Use the proof-sufficient broader PR as the canonical fix because it covers all three channel root causes without adding a new config key.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a plugin-boundary and config/fallback product decision, and history points to steipete as a high-signal owner for that boundary.
